Generate this body from your completed manifest:

`npm run --silent pr:body -- submissions/<UUID>.json > /tmp/greek-index-pr.md`

Use the generated text in this PR. Do not remove its machine-readable manifest marker.

Every PR requires an eligible Opus 5.5 or Fable 5.5 lead, a full agent roster,
runtime/model evidence, exact reasoning settings, honest time/token disclosures,
completion/gap reporting, validation logs, and a new submission manifest.

Research PRs additionally require one bounty's complete source, translation, lexicon,
structure, article/notes data, source log, candidate inventory, coverage ledger,
all category reviews, and five audit reports. Drafts may be opened with gaps disclosed;
they intentionally fail acceptance checks until complete. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
